title: Rentals Settlement Note: Wayfare Rentals Charges Paid from Driver Earnings
content:
Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, Wayfare Rentals charges are paid from the driver's earnings each week before the scheduled payout, oldest charge first. A deduction never takes the available balance below 0.00: when the balance does not cover a charge, only the balance is deducted and the remainder stays on the rental to be paid by card. A deduction is made only while the earnings account is active; nothing is deducted during a payout hold.

## By account status

| Earnings account status | Rental deduction made? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes, before the scheduled payout |
| On payout hold | No |

## Hypothetical weekly settlement

An active account has an available balance of 300.00 before the scheduled payout and two unpaid rental charges, an older one of 220.00 and a newer one of 180.00.

| Order | Charge | Deducted from earnings | Left on the rental, to be paid by card | Balance after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (oldest) | 220.00 | 220.00 | 0.00 | 80.00 |
| 2 | 180.00 | 80.00 | 100.00 | 0.00 |

The balance stops at 0.00 and nothing is left for that week's scheduled payout.
